item.description:
### Changed - **Perch uses less of your Mac while sessions run.** It no longer re-reads Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity and Muse session files every few seconds when nothing in them has changed.
### Fixed - **The "needs you" label stays on one session** when two sessions are waiting on you at once, instead of flipping between them. - **Perch can no longer freeze while replying to an agent** that has stopped listening; it gives up after half a second. - Perch's permission log is now readable only by your account, like its other logs.
